title: Improving the precision of shock resuscitation by predicting fluid responsiveness with machine learning and arterial blood pressure waveform data.
summary: A random-forest classifier using arterial blood-pressure waveforms predicted fluid responsiveness, defined as at least a 15% stroke-volume increase after fluid challenge, in retrospective data from 394 boluses in 58 pigs. It outperformed pulse-pressure variation across the reported train/test splits.
